ev-yellow-turban-rebellion:coord.reason: Ours is Julu (Hebei), where Zhang Jue rose in 184 (Hou Han shu 71). Wikidata's point near Zhengzhou is a generic placement, not the outbreak site.
checked: 范晔《后汉书》卷71 皇甫嵩传

ev-battle-of-guandu:coord.reason: Guandu lies NE of Zhongmu county, Zhengzhou (~34.75N 114.0E). Wikidata's point (114.62E) is east of Kaifeng, ~60 km from the battlefield.
checked: 陈寿《三国志》卷1 武帝纪 建安五年

ev-zhuge-liang-northern-expeditions:coor.reason: Marker is Mount Qi (Li county, Gansu), the first expedition's target; the full route is in route[]. Wikidata's 38N 102E is a rounded placeholder in the Hexi corridor, far from any campaign.
checked: 陈寿《三国志》卷35 诸葛亮传

ev-battle-of-fei-river:coord.reason: The battle was fought on the Fei River at Shouyang (modern Shou county, 32.58N 116.78E). Wikidata's point is ~95 km south near Lu'an/Hefei.
checked: Britannica: Battle of the Fei River (snippet via search)

ev-tang-conquest-of-eastern-turks:coord.reason: Both points are in the Yin Mountains and the camp site at Tieshan is not precisely known; ours (north of Baotou) is as defensible as Wikidata's rounded 41N 112E.
checked: 刘昫等《旧唐书》卷67 李靖传

ev-an-lushan-rebellion:coord.reason: Marker is Fanyang (Beijing), where An Lushan rose on 16 Dec 755. Wikidata's coordinate is the centroid of China in Gansu, not a historical site.
checked: 资治通鉴 卷217 天宝十四载

ev-huang-chao-rebellion:coord.reason: Marker is Yuanqu near Heze (Shandong), Huang Chao's home and where the rising began. Wikidata uses Chang'an, captured only in 881; ours fits the start year.
checked: 欧阳修等《新唐书》卷225下 黄巢传

ev-treaty-of-shaoxing:coord.reason: Wikidata's point is Shaoxing city, a misreading of the reign-era name. The treaty had no single signing site; our marker sits on the Huai River boundary it fixed.
checked: 脱脱等《宋史》卷29 高宗本纪 绍兴十一年

ev-red-turban-rebellion:coord.reason: Ours is Yingzhou (Fuyang, Anhui), where Liu Futong's rising began in 1351. Wikidata's coordinate in central Tibet is plainly wrong.
checked: 宋濂等《元史》卷42 顺帝本纪 至正十一年

ev-founding-of-ming:coord.reason: Zhu Yuanzhang was enthroned at Yingtian (Nanjing) in 1368. Wikidata's point is the Ming state centroid; the state QID has now been removed from this event record.
checked: 张廷玉等《明史》卷2 太祖本纪 洪武元年

ev-jingnan-campaign:coord.reason: Zhu Di launched the campaign from Beiping (Beijing) in 1399. Wikidata's point is Jinan, one siege in the war; ours is the origin and the victor's base.
checked: 张廷玉等《明史》卷5 成祖本纪

ev-revolt-of-three-feudatories:year.reason: The revolt broke out in late 1673 (Kangxi 12) and ended in 1681; Wikidata's 1681 is a point-in-time value for the end, while its own start is 1673.
checked: 赵尔巽等《清史稿》卷474 吴三桂传

ev-revolt-of-three-feudatories:coord.reason: Marker is Kunming, Wu Sangui's seat where the revolt began and ended (1681). Wikidata's coordinate is China's centroid in Gansu.
checked: 赵尔巽等《清史稿》卷474 吴三桂传

ev-first-opium-war:coord.reason: Marker is Humen at the Pearl River mouth, where the crisis began and early fighting took place. Wikidata's point is the generic China centroid.

ev-second-opium-war:coord.reason: The record covers the 1860 burning of the Yuanmingyuan; ours is the Old Summer Palace (40.008N 116.30E). Wikidata uses a rounded China centroid.
checked: 赵尔巽等《清史稿》卷20 文宗本纪 咸丰十年

ev-first-sino-japanese-war:coord.reason: Ours marks the Battle of the Yalu (Yellow Sea) off Dalu Island, the war's decisive naval action. Wikidata uses Seoul; both are defensible, so the curated marker stands.
checked: Britannica: First Sino-Japanese War (snippet via search)

ev-boxer-rebellion:coord.reason: The siege of the legations and the allied capture took place in Beijing. Wikidata's point in Inner Mongolia has no link to the events.

ev-xinhai-revolution:coord.reason: The record centres on Sun Yat-sen's inauguration as provisional president in Nanjing, 1 Jan 1912. Wikidata uses a generic China centroid.

ev-northern-expedition:year.reason: The expedition was launched from Guangzhou in July 1926 and ended in 1928 (Britannica: 1926–28). Wikidata's 1928 is the point-in-time of its end; its own start is 1926.

ev-northern-expedition:coord.reason: The expedition set out from Guangzhou. Wikidata's coordinate is China's centroid in Gansu.

ev-long-march:coord.reason: Marker is Zunyi, site of the January 1935 conference the summary highlights; the march had no single location. Wikidata's point is the China centroid.
checked: 中共中央党史和文献研究院《中国共产党一百年大事记》

ev-retrocession-of-taiwan:coord.reason: The surrender ceremony of 25 Oct 1945 was held at Taipei Public Hall (Zhongshan Hall, 25.04N 121.51E). Wikidata uses the island centroid.

ev-huaihai-campaign:coord.reason: The campaign centred on Xuzhou (34.26N 117.20E). Wikidata's point in central Shandong is outside the main theatre.

ev-first-chinese-nuclear-test:coord.reason: Ground zero of the 596 tower shot is given as 40°48′45″N 89°47′24″E, about 9 km from ours. Wikidata's point is near the Malan base, not the test ground.

person-wang-xizhi:born.reason: Scholars split between 303–361 (Britannica c. 303–c. 361; Jin shu age 59 sui) and 321–379. Curated 303 kept; record already has confidence medium and a note explaining both chronologies.
checked: 房玄龄等《晋书》卷80 王羲之传

polity-eastern-wu:from.reason: Sun Quan became King of Wu in 222, which Britannica and most references use as Wu's start (222–280); 229 is his imperial proclamation. Record note corrected (it wrongly said Wikidata uses 222).
checked: 陈寿《三国志》卷47 吴主传

polity-liang:to.reason: The Liang dynasty proper ended with Chen Baxian's usurpation in 557 (Britannica: 502–557). Wikidata's 587 counts the Western Liang rump state at Jiangling, a separate polity.

person-faxian:born.reason: Standard references give c. 337 (EBSCO research starter; Banglapedia). Wikidata's 340 is a rounded value. Both are approximate; record is medium confidence with a note.
